tests.name: Historical Matrix CNPG retention
tests.reason: The historical cluster and both original PVCs remain present; the source was not deleted or reinitialized. The pod remains in CrashLoopBackOff with 101 postgres restarts.

evidence.reference: matrix-mas-postgresql and original PGDATA/WAL PVC inventory

tests.name: Historical Matrix CNPG resource cost
tests.reason: The source retains 10Gi PGDATA plus 5Gi WAL and a 100m CPU/256Mi request, while current metrics show 1m CPU and 16Mi for the surviving plugin container. A reliable historical I/O cost metric was not available.

evidence.reference: atlantis-system events and pod startup logs; GitOps revision 0be68b014150267fa8c771ebd3cbb7a03b7015eb

tests.name: Atlantis route and readiness

tests.name: Global runtime smoke
